name: Astemizole

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 14 other countries, first in 1998 — for heart harm

summary: Astemizole was removed from the market in the United States and 14 other countries, starting in 1998, because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium score of 55 for liver issues [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a high score of 97 for heart issues [M].
